description: Clear proportionality violation with Constitutional Court support

input.problem_statement: Client charged with possessing 1g marijuana. Police conducted 5-hour search of entire home, seized computers and documents. Clear disproportionality. Constitutional Court precedent supports exclusion.

legal_arguments.title: Disproportionate search violates constitutional rights
legal_arguments.argument: 5-hour whole-home search for 1g marijuana violates proportionality principle
potential_counterarguments: Police may claim searching for larger quantity
Weak argument - no probable cause for larger amount

procedural_steps: File motion to suppress all evidence
Emphasize small quantity vs extensive search

weaknesses: Prosecution may argue they suspected larger amount
mitigation_suggestions: Show no probable cause existed for larger amount

validation_notes: Should score 22-46 (low risk) due to extreme disproportionality (5hr search for 1g), binding Constitutional Court precedent (2023) directly on point (91% match), clear constitutional violation, weak prosecution counter.
